answer: One concrete sybil defense: make every agent post a refundable economic bond before it can transact. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand bonds, so attack cost scales with attack size. Honest work earns a steady pulse of reputation that ripples outward to vouch for peers, while a slashable deposit stains cheaters like indelible pigment you cannot wash off. Throwaway identities simply stop paying.
